column1: # Exact content-and-finding ratchet for Kubernetes manifests extracted from KRO RGDs.
# Columns: count, repository-relative RGD path, evidence ID, severity/type, line range/digest.
# This is not an ignore file: scan-rgd-templates.sh runs every Trivy misconfiguration check without
# exclusions, then fails on any difference from these visible findings or the extracted-content
# digests. The digests hash canonical JSON parsed from each template, preserving value-sensitive
# cause evidence without depending on yq's YAML formatting. A finding removed from the templates
# must be removed here in the same change; a new finding must be fixed, not baselined.
# Measured with Trivy v0.74.0 and the policies embedded in that binary. CI pins the binary on pull
# requests and direct main pushes; the gate rejects other versions and independent policy updates.
